property.name: marginLeft
property.label: Left Margin (px)
property.description: Space to the left of the badge (0-40).

property.name: marginRight
property.label: Right Margin (px)
property.description: Space to the right of the badge (0-40).

property.name: previewTier
property.label: Preview Tier
property.description: Tier displayed in Experience Builder preview when no user loyalty data is available.

property.name: showPreviewFallback
property.label: Show Preview Fallback Badge
property.description: If true, shows the preview tier badge when live loyalty data is unavailable.

property.name: pinNearLogo
property.label: Pin Near Logo (Fixed Position)
property.description: Pins badge using fixed top/left offsets so it can sit near managed site logo.

property.name: fixedTopPx
property.label: Fixed Top Offset (px)
property.description: Distance from top of viewport when Pin Near Logo is enabled.

property.name: fixedLeftPx
property.label: Fixed Left Offset (px)
property.description: Distance from left of viewport when Pin Near Logo is enabled.

property.name: zIndex
property.label: Badge Z-Index
property.description: Stack order for fixed badge placement.
